name: VESTING DAY
description: An agent for England's merging councils (West Surrey, vesting day 1 April 2027). It federates three councils' published spend, contracts and Council Tax Support policy in place through Zetaris, plans which checks a broad question needs (NVIDIA Nemotron proposes the plan in live mode and the code validates it), resolves which suppliers they share, remembers every human decision with the Meterless H-MEM engine so later answers change, finds the contract cliff and the policy gaps residents hit on day one, and drafts the first actions under a human approval gate.

http.export: GET /export/{run_id}/{name}.csv (a full action list from that run; also written to logs/exports/<run_id>/)
http.evidence: GET /evidence (recorded live runs committed in logs/, read back, never re-run)

sample_mode.needs: nothing: no Zetaris, no Nightshift, no Companies House, no network
sample_mode.data: data/sample - the councils' published files mapped to one schema with provenance ids (data/raw holds the originals, data/raw/MANIFEST.md the URLs and hashes)
sample_mode.model: deterministic template badged sample-mode/template; all numbers computed at run time

agents.name: Router
agents.role: Classifies a free-text request into a supported flow (broad questions go to the Planner), reads councils and time windows, or returns a structured unsupported error

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Decides which checks a broad question needs (NVIDIA Nemotron proposes the plan in live mode; rules in sample mode), delegates them, assesses each result, revises steps that cannot run as asked, skips and names a failed step

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Runs federated SQL against the data layer (Zetaris live; cached council files in sample mode); widens an empty contract window when the Critic asks

agents.name: Resolver
agents.role: Normalises supplier names, scores cross-council matches, applies remembered decisions and Companies House identity

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Meterless H-MEM: recalls and stores human decisions with provenance

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Validates provenance, thresholds and claims: no number outside the evidence, no pair called confirmed without a human decision, SYNTHETIC residents labelled, a recalled human decision named; rejects and returns work that fails

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Drafts briefings and letters from the evidence table (NVIDIA Nemotron via Meterless Nightshift)

agents.name: ApprovalGate
agents.role: Holds drafts for human approval and records human confirmations; no autonomous action

sponsor_technology.zetaris: data layer: the three councils' spend, contracts and policy tables are registered in Zetaris and queried in place over its REST API (app/adapters/datalayer.py)
sponsor_technology.meterless_engine: H-MEM, implemented as a Python port of the reference (app/engines/hmem), conformance 13/13 on the upstream vectors (tests/test_hmem_conformance.py), bit-exact against the TypeScript reference (tests/test_hmem_golden.py), used by the Memory agent
sponsor_technology.meterless_nightshift: primary AI provider: app/adapters/nightshift.py speaks Nightshift's OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the runtime token; every response's signed compute receipt is kept
sponsor_technology.nvidia: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b through Nightshift: proposes the Planner's plan as JSON (validated by code), writes the briefings, letters and options note, and suggests SAME/DIFFERENT for uncertain supplier pairs (a suggestion for the human queue, never a decision); the model name and receipt are logged per request

development_tools: Built with Claude Code (an AI coding tool the event allows; Cursor was made optional on 22 Oct 2026). Cursor was not used. Every change was reviewed and committed by the author.
pre_existing_components: None. The first commit is 2026-10-24; all code was written during the build window. Third party: the Meterless H-MEM reference conformance vectors (Apache-2.0, third_party/hmem) and the councils' published open data (data/raw/MANIFEST.md).
traces: logs/trace-<run_id>.jsonl, one JSON object per agent action, written by the agents as they run
inputs: input_examples/*.json (run 01, 02, 03 in order to see memory change the answer; 07 is a broad question the Planner breaks into checks)
data_period: the newest six months each council has published (Woking Nov 2025-Apr 2026 monthly; Guildford and Waverley Apr-Sep 2026); every answer carries a per-council period badge
synthetic_data: data/sample/residents_synthetic.csv only, labelled SYNTHETIC in every output
limitations: Supplier identity below the exact/Companies-House bar is never asserted; it is queued for a human
Only the Lightning Nemotron lane is used (the Super-class endpoints were unavailable to this account during the event)
Waverley's Council Tax Support scheme is not yet in the clause table; the policy flow covers Woking and Guildford

The Router answers the supported question types (supplier overlap, contract cliff with any time window, Council Tax Support gap, confirm a match, approve a draft); anything else gets a structured unsupported error that lists them
